# Coordinate transform API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

Named, versioned mapping from a BrainSTEM coordinate type to an atlas.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/coordinatetransform/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/taxonomies/coordinatetransform/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `coordinate_transform` (detail, create, update), `coordinate_transforms` (list)
- **Permissions:** see the [permissions page](/datamodel/permissions/)
- **Uniqueness:** `code` unique across BrainSTEM
- **Deleting:** refused (400) while [`procedure`](/api/modules/procedure/) records point to it

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `code` | string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[read-only]** |
| `version` | string **[read-only]** |
| `source_coordinate_system` | choice (see the list below) **[read-only]** |
| `anatomical_reference` | [`anatomicalreference`](/api/taxonomies/anatomicalreference/) id **[read-only]** |
| `mapping_kind` | one of `identity`, `affine_4x4`, `stereotaxic_surface` **[read-only]** |
| `quality` | one of `exact`, `estimated` **[read-only]** |
| `method_description` | string **[read-only]** |
| `provenance_url` | string **[read-only]** |
| `citation` | string **[read-only]** |
| `warning` | string **[read-only]** |
| `implementation_version` | number **[read-only]** |
| `is_active` | boolean **[read-only]** |

- `source_coordinate_system` choices: `External_XYZ_Euler`, `External_XYZ_Quaternion`, `Stereotaxic_BregmaAbsolute`, `Stereotaxic_BregmaBrainSurface`, `Stereotaxic_LambdaAbsolute`, `Stereotaxic_LambdaBrainSurface`, `Landmark_APMLDV_Absolute`, `Landmark_APML_SurfaceDepth`, `Spinal_RCMLDV_Absolute`, `Spinal_RCML_SurfaceDepth`, `CCF_XYZ_Absolute`, `WHS_XYZ_Absolute`, `MNI152_XYZ_Absolute`, `NMT_XYZ_Absolute`, `MapZebrain_XYZ_Absolute`, `JRC2018U_XYZ_Absolute`, `BMA_XYZ_Absolute`

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/coordinatetransform/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('coordinatetransform', load_all=True)
records = resp['coordinate_transforms']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('coordinatetransform', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.coordinate_transforms;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "coordinate_transforms": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "code": "",
            "name": "Coordinate transform 1",
            "version": "",
            "source_coordinate_system": "External_XYZ_Euler",
            "anatomical_reference": "<anatomicalreference-id>",
            "mapping_kind": "identity",
            "quality": "exact",
            "method_description": "",
            "provenance_url": "",
            "citation": "",
            "warning": "",
            "implementation_version": 1,
            "is_active": true
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/coordinatetransform/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('coordinatetransform', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['coordinate_transform']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('coordinatetransform', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.coordinate_transform;
```

## Writing

This resource is maintained by BrainSTEM administrators or system processes and is read-only through the REST API.

## Data model

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Coordinate transform data model page](/datamodel/taxonomies/coordinatetransform/).
